d: At least 153 people have reportedly been killed in a drone strike on a busy market in Abyei, a disputed territory between Sudan and South Sudan. South Sudan has blamed Sudan’s military and summoned its ambassador in protest. The strike reportedly hit a fuel depot linked to Sudan’s paramilitary Rapid Support Forces, adding a new flashpoint to a war that has displaced more than 14 million people. Why did this attack trigger a diplomatic row, and could Sudan’s war spread further? Palki Sharma tells you.
